items.claim: Magomed throws with insane volume and had around 400 strikes in a three-round Contender Series fight.
items.quote: he threw like 400 strikes in a three-round Contender Series fight.

items.claim: Magomed is not known as a big power finisher, but rather as someone who breaks people with volume and intent.
items.quote: he's not known as this big power finisher. He's known as breaking people.

items.claim: Islam Dulatov is a striker with power, movement, body and leg work, solid takedown defense, and offensive submissions.
items.quote: He's a striker. He's got power, plenty of movement, does a really good job working the body and the legs. His takedown defense is pretty solid as well, and he has some offensive submissions

items.claim: Wellington Turman is coming off a three-year layoff and three consecutive losses.
items.quote: He's coming off three losses in a row... Then he took a three-year layoff and now here he is back after three years no fighting.

items.claim: Wellington Turman is a good grappler who will chase submissions in scrambles.
items.quote: he is a good grappler. He will find submissions. He'll chase them. He doesn't even need like a clean takedown. He'll just look for a scramble

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov is a lightning-fast striker with crazy power who moves forward and hunts for the knockout.
items.quote: Ramazan Temirov's a guy that's going to move forward. He's a lightning fast striker. He's not a big dude but he's got crazy power.

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov can be rocked on the feet.
items.quote: it doesn't take a ton of tape study to see that he can be rocked

items.claim: Ramazan Temirov served a short suspension for a tainted heart medication supplement rather than steroids.
items.quote: he did get suspended for a tainted tainted supplement, but we're not talking steroids. It was something like in his heart medication.

items.claim: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has added striking and high fight IQ, but relies on favorable matchups.
items.quote: Steve Erceg is a decent wrestler who has evolved, added some striking, and I think he's high IQ... getting by with A, favorable matchups, and B, his fight IQ.
